title: R676 S5: analytic SDF silhouette coverage in the recipe march (single-frame cross-boundary AA)
body: op-aaedges: TAA resolves silhouettes, contact lines and shadow edges on a still camera (edge error vs 16x reference 1-2 vs 11-15 raw) and, after 89d395cb, during a pan better than raw on every class; what is left is the first frames after a cut, disocclusions and residual stairs on fast pans, which only a single-frame coverage term fixes. R676.6 S5 is ruled: keep min d/(t*pixelAngle) along the march, convert to coverage on escape/behind-hit, composite with the regime-3 behindColor (TraceWorld.glsl), presentation only, CanonicalCapture bytes unchanged. Author the coverage as kernel callables (R619.1). Tier sol: march-level shader change with a second-hit colour and a Dozen witness loop.

title: Look-dev review crops for the owner must come from the presentation capture path, not the canonical one
body: op-aaedges: the owner judged AA on cx-shadowedge's crops, which are canonical captures (one raw unjittered sample by R676.2, so no AA on any boundary). Since cb9db5de the harness has VIXEN_LOOKDEV_CAPTURE_SAMPLING=presentation and the Application.LookdevCapture.Presentation.<state> tests. Visual lanes should attach presentation crops (and say which path) whenever the owner judges a look; canonical stays the parity/regression witness. Tier haiku: a line in _visual-lane-rules.md and the look-dev crop scripts' default.
